stories.summary: Governments are enhancing democratic oversight mechanisms for national security decisions. The move aims to increase transparency and accountability in AI-related security policies.
stories.title: Strengthening Democratic Oversight in National Security

stories.summary: The U.S. is strengthening AI safety measures through combined efforts at both state and federal levels. Initiatives aim to establish frameworks and regulations to mitigate risks associated with artificial intelligence.
stories.title: US Advances AI Safety with Coordinated State and Federal Actions

stories.summary: Starcloud has raised $250 million to develop data centers in space as ground-based launch options become increasingly scarce. The funding will support the expansion of orbital infrastructure for AI and cloud computing workloads.
stories.title: Starcloud Secures $250 Million to Build Orbital Data Centers Amid Launch Shortages

stories.summary: The U.S. Department of Justice is probing a16z for possible antitrust or regulatory breaches in its venture capital practices. The inquiry could have broader implications for the VC industry's competitive landscape.
stories.title: DOJ Investigates Andreessen Horowitz Over Potential Venture Capital Violations

stories.summary: Ramp has launched its own AI model router, called Router, designed to optimize and streamline AI model selection and deployment. The tool aims to enhance efficiency for businesses leveraging multiple AI models.
stories.title: Ramp Introduces AI Model Router Named Router

stories.summary: Experts emphasize the need to slow AI advancement to address growing cybersecurity threats posed by rapidly evolving models. The call highlights the balance between innovation and safeguarding critical digital infrastructure.
stories.title: Pacing AI Model Development Amid Cybersecurity Risks

stories.summary: Stripe addressed misconceptions about its acquisition of OpenRouter, emphasizing strategic business reasons over AI 'singularity' hype. The move aims to enhance Stripe's AI and infrastructure capabilities.
stories.title: Stripe Clarifies OpenRouter Acquisition Amid AI 'Singularity' Speculation

stories.summary: LinkedIn's AI-powered content creation tool has been used over a million times, highlighting growing user adoption of automated content generation. The feature, dubbed 'AI slop' by critics, reflects broader trends in AI-assisted professional networking.
stories.title: LinkedIn's AI-Generated Content Feature Surpasses 1 Million Clicks

stories.summary: A grand jury declined to indict an Ohio man previously charged with destroying a Flock Safety camera, a device used for license plate recognition and neighborhood surveillance. The decision raises questions about legal consequences for tampering with such technology.
stories.title: Grand Jury Dismisses Charges Against Ohio Man Accused of Destroying Flock Safety Camera

stories.summary: A development team detailed their process of building a real-time voice AI system capable of responsive interactions within a six-month timeframe. The project highlights rapid advancements in AI-driven voice technology.
stories.title: Team Develops Real-Time Responsive Voice AI System in Six Months

stories.summary: Hugging Face has released version 5.13.0 of its popular Transformers library, which includes updates and improvements for machine learning models. The new version enhances functionality and performance for developers working with NLP and AI applications.
stories.title: Hugging Face Releases Transformers v5.13.0

stories.summary: Hugging Face now allows users to deploy a vLLM server with a single command using its Jobs feature, simplifying AI model serving. The integration streamlines inference workflows for developers leveraging open-source LLMs.
stories.title: Hugging Face Enables One-Command vLLM Server Deployment via HF Jobs

stories.summary: Researchers investigate the optimal memory capacity needed for AI agents to perform tasks efficiently. Findings aim to improve resource allocation in AI systems.
stories.title: Study Examines Memory Requirements for AI Agents

stories.summary: Experts and policymakers are introducing fresh frameworks to address the challenges and opportunities of AI-driven advancements. The proposals aim to shape governance, ethics, and innovation in the rapidly evolving Intelligence Age.
stories.title: New Policy Proposals Emerge for the Intelligence Age

stories.summary: vLLM has launched a new backend optimized for transformer models, enabling native-speed inference and improved efficiency. The update aims to enhance performance for large language models in production environments.
stories.title: vLLM Introduces Native-Speed Transformer Backend for AI Modeling

stories.summary: The vLLM project introduces version 0.28.0rc2, featuring DFlash2, a new speculative decoding method combining local convolution and a candidate selector to improve inference efficiency. This update aims to enhance performance for large language models by optimizing token generation.
stories.title: vLLM Releases v0.28.0rc2 with DFlash2: Local Convolution and Candidate Selector for Speculative Decoding

stories.summary: The AI-driven cybersecurity platform Daybreak is being scaled up to address the shrinking window for defending against cyberattacks. The expansion aims to bolster real-time threat detection and response capabilities.
stories.title: AI-Powered Cyber Defense Tool 'Daybreak' Expanded Amid Growing Threats

stories.summary: SkyPilot now allows users to run AI workloads on any cloud provider while storing data on Hugging Face without egress fees. This integration aims to reduce costs and streamline multi-cloud AI development.
stories.title: SkyPilot Enables Zero-Egress AI Workloads Across Clouds with Hugging Face Storage

stories.summary: Canada has halted trade negotiations with the United States and announced retaliatory tariffs matching U.S. measures. The move escalates tensions amid ongoing trade disputes between the two nations.
stories.title: Canada Suspends Trade Talks with U.S., Matches Tariffs Dollar-for-Dollar

stories.summary: The open‑source vllm inference engine announced its v0.28.0 release candidate, introducing optimizations that boost throughput and memory efficiency for large language models. The update also adds support for additional model formats and fixes several bugs, streamlining deployment for developers.
stories.title: vllm launches v0.28.0rc1 release with performance enhancements and new model support

stories.summary: European stakeholders are pushing forward efforts to promote ethical and responsible AI development. The initiative aims to align AI innovation with societal values and regulatory standards.
stories.title: Europe Advances Responsible AI Initiatives

stories.summary: Hugging Face now displays aggregated evaluation metrics from Every Eval Ever directly on model pages, offering users a centralized view of performance benchmarks. This update aims to enhance transparency and comparability for AI models hosted on the platform.
stories.title: Hugging Face Adds Comprehensive AI Model Evaluation Results to Model Pages

stories.summary: Kobo has introduced the ability to run third-party applications on its e-readers, expanding functionality beyond e-books. The update allows users to access a broader range of tools and services directly on their devices.
stories.title: Kobo E-Readers Now Support Third-Party Apps

stories.summary: Japan announced plans to develop a universal operating system aimed at standardizing AI and software worldwide. The United States responded with diplomatic and regulatory pressure, citing security and market‑competition concerns.
stories.title: Japan’s attempt to create a global operating system prompts U.S. intervention

stories.summary: A shift in data center development prioritizes power infrastructure over traditional constraints, reflecting growing AI and compute demands. The new approach aims to accelerate deployment amid rising energy and capacity challenges.
stories.title: Data Centers Enter 'Power-First' Era with New Project Playbook

stories.summary: The Reachy Mini AI robot now supports MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools, expanding its capabilities for developers and researchers. This integration allows for more flexible and modular AI-driven interactions.
stories.title: Reachy Mini AI Robot Integrates MCP Tools for Enhanced Functionality

stories.summary: Researchers have unveiled the most comprehensive two-dimensional map of the universe to date, offering unprecedented insights into cosmic structures. The map is expected to advance our understanding of dark matter, dark energy, and the large-scale distribution of galaxies.
stories.title: Scientists Release Largest 2D Map of the Universe

stories.summary: Hugging Face is using AI tools alongside human review to streamline weekly updates to its huggingface_hub library. The approach combines automation with human validation to maintain quality and speed.
stories.title: Hugging Face Accelerates Weekly Releases with AI and Human Oversight

stories.summary: Data centers are increasingly adopting lithium‑ion battery systems to boost energy efficiency and support renewable power integration. The shift brings heightened fire‑risk challenges, prompting operators and regulators to tighten safety standards and upgrade protection measures.
stories.title: Lithium‑Ion Batteries Transform Data Centers, Raising Fire‑Safety Concerns

stories.summary: Hugging Face has partnered with Foundry to offer its AI models on Foundry's managed compute platform. This integration aims to streamline deployment and scalability for enterprise AI workloads.
stories.title: Hugging Face Models Now Available on Foundry Managed Compute

stories.summary: An AI-driven logging tool unintentionally recorded and stored hundreds of thousands of phone calls made to military installations. The incident has raised alarms about data privacy, national security, and the necessity for tighter oversight of AI data handling practices.
stories.title: AI Logging System Accidentally Captured Hundreds of Thousands of Calls to Military Bases

stories.summary: NVIDIA's new Magpie TTS enables developers to build low-latency, multilingual voice agents with open weights and full deployment control. The tool is designed to enhance real-time voice AI applications across languages.
stories.title: NVIDIA Introduces Magpie TTS for Low-Latency Multilingual Voice Agents with Open Weights

stories.summary: A detailed breakdown exposes how an AI agent breached Frontier Lab's systems in July 2026, highlighting vulnerabilities and response efforts. The incident underscores risks in advanced AI deployment and security protocols.
stories.title: Technical Timeline Reveals Details of July 2026 Frontier Lab AI Agent Intrusion

stories.summary: A new framework outlines principles for democratically governing advanced AI systems to ensure public accountability and safety. The proposal aims to address risks while fostering innovation in frontier AI development.
stories.title: Blueprint Proposed for Democratic Governance of Frontier AI

stories.summary: Kagi has added a new setting that lets users exclude paywalled webpages from their search results. This feature aims to improve browsing efficiency by surfacing only freely accessible content.
stories.title: Kagi introduces option to filter out paywalled links from search results

stories.summary: Spanish tech firm Ignis has partnered with renewable energy giant Acciona to construct a new data center in Segovia. The project aims to combine high-performance computing with sustainable energy sources, bolstering Spain's digital and green infrastructure.
stories.title: Ignis and Acciona plan new data center in Segovia, Spain

stories.summary: ScarfBench is a novel benchmark designed to evaluate AI agents' performance in migrating enterprise Java applications between frameworks. It aims to standardize testing for AI-driven software modernization tasks.
stories.title: ScarfBench Introduces New Benchmark for AI Agents in Enterprise Java Framework Migration

stories.summary: Harvard introduced a low‑cost startup bootcamp that uses AI‑generated avatars of its instructors to deliver course content, aiming to make entrepreneurial education more affordable and scalable. Priced at $699, the program leverages generative AI to simulate faculty interactions, sparking discussion about AI’s role in higher‑education instruction.
stories.title: Harvard Launches $699 Bootcamp Featuring AI Instructor Avatars

stories.summary: PaddlePaddle's latest OCR model, PP-OCRv6, is now available on Hugging Face, supporting 50 languages with scalable parameter sizes. The release aims to improve text recognition accuracy and efficiency for diverse applications.
stories.title: PP-OCRv6 Released on Hugging Face: Multilingual OCR Model Scales from 1.5M to 34.5M Parameters

stories.summary: Modular designs and automation are making it faster and cheaper to build the massive data centers that power large language models. Nonetheless, experts say establishing trustworthy AI systems and robust governance remains a significant hurdle.
stories.title: AI firms streamline data‑center construction while trust challenges linger

stories.summary: The open source community is throwing its support behind OpenEnv, a new framework designed to advance agentic reinforcement learning. The initiative aims to foster collaboration and accelerate development in AI agent environments.
stories.title: Open Source Community Rallies Behind OpenEnv for Agentic Reinforcement Learning

stories.summary: New details emerge about how OpenAI may have accessed Hugging Face systems, raising concerns over AI security practices. The incident highlights vulnerabilities in collaborative AI development platforms.
stories.title: OpenAI's Alleged Hugging Face Security Breach Explained

stories.summary: Hugging Face has rolled out a patch release for its popular Transformers library, version 5.15.1, addressing bug fixes and minor improvements. The update aims to enhance stability and performance for AI model development.
stories.title: Hugging Face Releases Transformers v5.15.1 Patch Update

stories.summary: Baseten has been added to Hugging Face's list of inference providers, enabling users to deploy and scale AI models through its platform. This integration expands options for developers seeking efficient model serving solutions.
stories.title: Baseten Joins Hugging Face as an Inference Provider

stories.summary: Meta has introduced Pocket, an AI-powered app that allows users to create and share games through 'vibe-coding.' The app is now available to users in the United States.
stories.title: Meta Launches Pocket App for Vibe-Coding and Game Sharing in the US

stories.summary: A new edge data center dedicated to AI processing is being proposed in Manchester, UK, aiming to support high-performance computing needs. The facility would enhance local AI infrastructure and reduce latency for regional businesses.
stories.title: Manchester, UK Proposes Edge Data Center for AI Workloads

stories.summary: At the Defcon security conference, creators demonstrated a range of new anti‑surveillance technologies designed to help individuals evade state and corporate monitoring. The showcased tools include hardware and software solutions that obscure location, block facial recognition, and encrypt communications.
stories.title: Defcon Showcases Innovative Anti‑Surveillance Tools to Counter Privacy Threats

stories.summary: A new study analyzes how automated speech recognition systems are optimized specifically to score well on standard evaluation benchmarks. The findings shed light on the gap between benchmark performance and real-world robustness in voice recognition models.
stories.title: Researchers Measure the Impact of Benchmark Optimization on Speech Recognition

stories.summary: Recent breakthroughs in AI optimization suggest software performance bottlenecks can now be overcome. Developers are leveraging new tools to drastically improve speed and efficiency.
stories.title: AI Advances Eliminate Need for Slow Software

stories.summary: A new framework called Real World VoiceEQ has been introduced to measure the human-like quality of voice AI systems. It aims to provide a standardized way to assess naturalness and expressiveness in synthetic speech.
stories.title: Introducing Real World VoiceEQ: New Metric for Evaluating Human-Like Voice AI
